lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - A Listen & read

details: Listen and read introduces students to informational text about real teen weekend habits. It builds understanding of percentages, comparative popularity of activities, and new vocabulary used to describe trends.
Look for students following the reading, identifying the most and least popular activities, showing comprehension through pointing or short responses, and correctly recognising key data.

“Do you want to know what other teenagers do on the weekend? Do you think that teenagers in other countries like to do different things?. Look at this graph about Korean teens, is it the same for you? What’s the most popular thing to do here? I know what my favourite thing is - but I’m not a teenager!”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - B. Answer the questions

details: Answer the questions checks comprehension of the reading by helping students locate specific information, interpret numerical data, and make meaning from the text to make accurate answers.
Look for correct  answers, students referring back to the graph and reading passage, and being able to show where they found each piece of information.

“I want to know what activities are trending. Can you help me find out so I can recommend trending activities to other kids? Let’s find the most popular, and the least popular! Can you figure out why?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:
Check and encourage Ss to complete the project prompts so that they are ready to present by lesson 7,

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Writing Lesson - A Lead in-pair discussion

details: Students activate schema by discussing questions  related to the topic and their own lives.
Look for…two-way discussion, ability to share relevant ideas and experiences

lessonPlan.topic: Writing Lesson - B Read & analyse model

details: Students read and understand the text content, and notice key features of the genre
Look for… focused reading, correct answers to comprehension questions, ability to identify genre features
Students learn the writing skill, notice its use in the model, practice using it
Look for… correct skill identification, correct answers
Students brainstorm or make notes to plan their final writing
Look for… detailed note-making, relevant details, creativity

Students produce 
their final writing using their notes, the model and checklist
Look for… output relevancy, correct genre features, use of writing skill, accurate spelling and grammar

Diary:
Revisit the diary page so Ss can add new words or phrases, revisit their learning goal and complete tracking for that lesson.
